takeaway: Plain backdrop or a bare room (a chair, wallpaper at most), controlled light, the garment is the subject: full length, a turn, close-ups of boning and lacing. 109 ads, 82 of them Bupbes, so this group mostly shows how Bupbes shoots; only 20 are still running. RUE de RUE’s black corset set in a white room has run 356 days.
sher_test: The cheapest look to repeat: one corset on grey seamless, a 6–8 s video (front, turn, lacing close-up, back). Use it as the control the other looks are tested against, not as the proven winner: its long runs are mostly Bupbes ads that ended in campaign flights.

takeaway: Looks self-filmed: mirror selfies, try-ons presented to camera (even in a staged showroom), snapshots at dinner. 42 ads, mostly JC de JC and JUBIN STUDIO, mostly videos; 39 still running, the highest share of any look. JUBIN’s 18 s garden try-on has run 418 days; RUE de RUE’s customer-photo carousel 245.
sher_test: A KOL try-on of one corset as a 15–20 s phone video, presented to camera, against the studio video on the same budget.

takeaway: A photographer in a real place with natural poses and no concept: villa rooms, hotel balconies, stone courtyards, staircases. 28 ads, mostly IAM COCO, JC de JC and Cherie; 23 still running. IAM COCO’s “Siren Call” set on a hotel balcony at sunset has run 172 days.
sher_test: The middle option SHER can shoot often: one model, one good Bangkok location, 4–6 photos per corset.

takeaway: A concept shoot: a built set, props or theatrical light, or a wild place (river and forest, sea rocks, a field with a horse), styled like a magazine. 30 ads from IAM COCO, Maël and Bupbes; 26 still running but most started in October, so it is too early to say how long they last. Maël’s Cruise ’26 sea-rock set has run 170 days.
sher_test: One campaign shoot per collection, run against the studio video to see if the extra cost earns longer runs. Re-check in a month when IAM COCO’s October ads have aged.

takeaway: No person: packshots on white, hanger shots, styled flat-lays with handwritten names, a hand opening the box. Only 9 ads, 8 still running: JUBIN STUDIO’s corset flat-lay carousel has run 489 days (the longest ad in the file), Maël’s corset sheet 121 days.
sher_test: Cheapest to make: a 5-card carousel of corset tops laid flat on fabric, each named. Try it as retargeting first.

takeaway: Text-led designs, not a shoot: an article-style carousel listing Vietnamese brands, a rental shop’s promo card. 2 ads, both by other businesses naming the brand.
sher_test: None; kept so other businesses’ ads stay visible.
